verses.text: A psalm by David. The LORD says to my Lord, “Take your seat at my right hand until I put your enemies under your feet like a footstool.”
The LORD will extend the scepter of your strength from Zion. Rule right in the middle of your enemies.
On the day you show your power, your people will step forward willingly in holy splendor. From the womb of dawn comes the dew of your youth.
The LORD has sworn an oath and won’t change his mind: “You’re a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
The Lord is at your right hand. When his anger comes, he’ll crush kings.
He’ll judge the nations and pile up the dead. He’ll crush the ruler over the whole earth.
He’ll drink from the stream along the way, then lift his head high.
